summary.en: Minimal conda installer for Python environments, with a Windows-arm64 installer.
summary.zh-TW: 精簡版 conda 安裝程式，用於管理 Python 環境，提供 Windows-arm64 安裝檔。

evidence.title: NVIDIA: RTX Spark getting started with development (native Windows ARM64 Miniconda installer)

caveats.en: NVIDIA's RTX Spark guide recommends this installer, but it does not test every conda package. Some Python packages still lack Windows Arm64 wheels.
caveats.zh-TW: NVIDIA 的 RTX Spark 指南建議使用此安裝程式，但並未測試所有 conda 套件，部分 Python 套件仍缺少 Windows Arm64 wheel。
